strings.ID_MAINMENU_SCR_PLAY_CATEGORY_HERO_DESC: Heroes and Villains clash in epic battles across cinematic eras.
strings.ID_MAINMENU_SCR_PLAY_CATEGORY_SANDBOX_DE: A diverse set of game modes explore scenarios from across the galaxy, challenging players in unique and exciting ways!

strings.ID_M_SCR_MODE8_DESC: Single player epic battles against AI opponents offline. Take control over a majority of Command Posts to gain reinforcements and defeat the enemy team.

strings.ID_ONLINEHUB_GROUP_EMPTY_TEXT: Invite friends and then choose what to play in the Play menu. The whole group will be matchmade and kept together.
strings.ID_ONLINEHUB_IN_QUEUE: Server full. Placed in a queue to join, position: {0:d}
strings.ID_OPTIONS_SCR_FULLSCREEN_RESOLUTION_DES: Changes the resolution for the selected monitor in fullscreen.
strings.ID_OPTIONS_SCR_HDR_BRIGHTNESS_DESCRIPTIO:
Calibrate the peak brightness to optimize the rendering output to match the brightness range of your tv. This gives you more detailed highlights in the picture.

Set the slider to the lowest value where the two rectangles still look identical.
strings.ID_OPTIONS_SCR_RESET_TUTORIALS_HELP: Resetting the tutorials will make all the tutorials show up again like they did the first time you played.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_CAMPAIGN_DESCRIPTION: Fight for the Empire as Commander Iden Versio, leader of the Empire's extraordinary special operations team: Inferno Squad.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_CAMPAIGN_MISSIONSELECT_DESC: Replay any completed chapter with a new loadout, different abilities, or to locate hidden collectibles.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_MODE1_DESC: Armies collide to dominate the battlefront in an open-ended tug-of-war. Utilize a wide array of tactics, trooper classes, land vehicles, reinforcement units, and hero characters to attack and defend strategic assets in this era-authentic mode.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_MODE9_DESC: Join a squad of four players and go up against the enemy team of AI opponents. As an attacker, capture one of the Command Posts to continue the battle into the next phase. As a defender, prevent the enemies from capturing any of your Command Posts to stop their advance.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_MULTIPLAYER_DESCRIPTION: A selection of multiplayer modes, from large to small, that let you to take control of your favorite characters, pilot extraordinary vehicles, and visit beautiful worlds.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_RESTARTCAMPAIGN_DESC: Restart the story and experience Inferno Squad’s journey from the beginning. This will erase existing save data.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SINGLEPLAYER_DESC: Fight through the Campaign of Iden Versio, jump into larger-than-life Star Wars battles against AI foes in Instant Action, or take on a variety of scenarios in Arcade.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_COOP_DESC: Team up with a friend in a split-screen co-op Arcade.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_DARK_SIDE_DESC: Show no mercy and prove your allegiance to the Separatists, the Galactic Empire, or the First Order.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_DESCRIPTION: Become a master of combat with Arcade. Fight against AI-controlled enemies and earn rewards as you learn to master all of your troopers, heroes, weapons and abilities.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_LIGHT_SIDE_DESC: Resist the powers of evil and join the fight in the name of the Republic, the Rebel Alliance, or the Resistance.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_SINGLE_DESC: Take on Arcade by yourself and face off against the AI.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_TUTORIAL_DESC: Learn the basics of trooper and hero combat in Battlefront II. Destroy the Resistance forces daring enough to attack Starkiller Base as a First Order trooper or as Kylo Ren himself.
strings.ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_VERSUS_DESC: Go head-to-head in a split-screen versus Arcade.
strings.ID_SPAWN_SCR_UNLOCK_IN_COLLECTION_SCREEN: UNLOCK HERO IN THE COLLECTION MENU
